posts.subject: Moderator
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello my name is Toad


I would like to apply to this big community,


I wanna be a Moderator because i wanna help your community with people that are breaking the rules etc.
I can also help you with your Teamspeak server i've been admin on 4 Teamspeak servers before, i never got kicked they just got shut down [ddos1] .
I am also really active I play 4 - 8 hours everyday.


😄 Things about my self 😄


- I am 14 years old
- I work hard and take stuff seroiusly
- I am from Norway
- I can speak English really good
- I play in the knife server everyday
- I love to work






I hope you consider me being a Moderator, I would appreciate being in your community team.
I hope you guys give me a fast response [;)]

I give you a NO because of the following reasons
- Application is written poorly you could have used a Example
- This is your first post on the forum
- You're not really active on the teaspeak
- You're not really well mixed within the community enough
- You're not 16 years old which is a required requirements
- You did not really tell us alot about yourself



I can't think of more reasons but this should give you plenty enought to improve yourself and maybe apply next month or after a two or three months so people know you better and have better view of you

Hi Toad,


It's nice to see you try to help the Dream community but your application is a bit off in terms of detail and structure.
You seem like a very nice guy on the servers and you have told me you have had many past experiences with an admin position.


However, for me, it is a NO because you aren't connected with the community as much, if not, at all and your application is very lacking.
If you was to get denied from the application, I would strongly suggest you to see the following posts before making your application again next month if desired:


Admin Requirements: Application Requirements | Read before posting!
Application Structure Template: Application Example | Read before posting!


Thanks for applying,
Doo Doo
